title: Review of lab 1's active-droplets/ad4-protocell (IB): the amphiphile shell replicates on fresh seeds 3 and 4 (psi rim/core 4.0, rim/out 18.5-19.8, membrane-like in 64/64 and 62/64 droplets) around discrete droplets (12 at the end, 6 persistent splits, generation 2)
summary: Labkit packs of threads/active-droplets/worlds/ad4-protocell/world.py, unchanged, 128^2, t=0-20000. 12 droplets at the end on both seeds, 7 splits, 6 persistent, generation 2, 1 merge. Only the amphiphile psi is membrane-like: rim/core 4.0 on both seeds, rim/out 18.5 and 19.8, 64/64 and 62/64 droplets individually; droplet material, catalysts and fuel are not (rim/core 0.88-0.94). The two seeds give almost identical numbers.

seeds_run.result: pass: I B (nearly identical to seed 3)

verdicts.limitation: The two seeds are nearly identical (planted or weakly seed-dependent start), so they add little independence. The shell is a quasi-equilibrium coating of a droplet-made amphiphile, as in ad3; I did not run a source ablation. Generation 2 only, as lab 1 noted.
